entries.title: II Timothy 3:1
segments: The last days. The apostles seem to have expected the immediate return of Christ in glory-the second coming-in their own generation.  They did not foresee the long and painful spread of the leaven of Christianity, although Jesus had warned them that only the Father had this knowledge.  See

segments: Jannes and Jambres.  The names handed down by the Jewish traditions as those of the Egyptian sorcerers who wrought wonders in opposition to Moses and Aaron.  See

segments: Being deceived. A false teacher who is himself a victim of his own delusions Is the most dangerous of all, having the power added by sincerity.  See
